title: Tools missing.
text:
First kit called for hammer, but hammer didnt come til following kit.
The kit uses very small nails, which are impossible to hold by adult or child of 7 yrs old. Buy needle nose pliers before attempting to use. Also need to buy hammer. I was under impression all tools were included with kit.
Later kit calls for square, but none included in this kit either.
These kits can not be done by young child without adult supervision & assistance.
If kits preprimed would be helpful as paint supplied soaks into wood, does not apoear like picture.
Be aware that kit takes several hours, days, due to continued gluing, then later painting. Poor for young child with short attention span. May be better for older child. I ended up trying to do most of project myself. I was looking for something to build his skills not mine.
